notes.title: Overhaul Update
notes.content:
We have overhauled some thing to make the game more pleasant to look and made some minor improvements & bug fixes!


 Updated graphics
 Updated store page
 Fixed bugs and improved existing systems


If you have questions or want to chat about the update, join the Discord!
https://discord.com/invite/Mk2c3msVNT

-GreepyBrains

notes.title: Small patch #1
notes.content:
Added a sound when someone joins a lobby
 Fixed the "invite friends" button
 Added error message if you fail to connect to the ranked game server

notes.title: Tutorial improvements!
notes.content:
We have noticed that the tutorial is not in the best shape, so we made some improvements, and will keep improving it in the future!

List of improvements:

 Fixed a bug where the tutorial CPU could take pieces while his piece was under a tower.
 Added a notification when the next step is ready.
 Improved visibility in the main menu.


If you have questions or want to chat about the update, join the Discord!
https://discord.com/invite/Mk2c3msVNT


-GreepyBrains
